title: Surreal Cosmic Larva
description: A large transparent bubble floats in space containing a surreal scene with two cartoonish white larvae, one large at the bottom with oversized green-purple eyes and another smaller one hanging from the top. A golden skeletal structure drips honey-like liquid, purple lightning crackles throughout, and a black silhouetted figure with raised arms stands against a colorful nebula. A purple planet and desert landscape are visible in the background.
prompt: Surreal scene inside a large transparent bubble floating in outer space, two cartoon larvae with big glossy eyes, one large white caterpillar-like creature at the bottom with vibrant green and purple eyes, a smaller larva hanging from the top, golden skeletal dripping structure oozing honey, purple electric lightning bolts, black silhouetted figure with arms raised, purple planet and desert dunes in background, colorful nebula clouds, whimsical and bizarre atmosphere, detailed digital painting
